milestones.name: Unlock Dash/Deflect
milestones.note: Unlocking this skill makes combat much more engaging; functions as a parry/deflect rather than a traditional dash

milestones.name: Unlock Gliding
milestones.note: Becomes available later in the game, around 8 hours in; essential for crossing large gaps and accessing new areas

milestones.name: Unlock Orbs (Projectile Attacks)
milestones.note: Ranged projectile attacks, especially useful against flying enemies

milestones.name: Unlock Decoy Clones
milestones.note: Creates decoy clones to distract enemies and attack from multiple directions simultaneously

milestones.name: First Network Gate visit
milestones.note: Used to spend Liquid Nacre on upgrades, modifications, and max health increases

milestones.name: Find Solid Nacre conversion robot
milestones.note: Robots scattered throughout The Vessel convert Liquid Nacre into permanent Solid Nacre

zones.name: The Vessel
zones.fingerprintHint: Primary world/map in MIO: Memories in Orbit; contains enemies, Network Gates, Solid Nacre conversion robots, and platforming sections

zones.name: Network Gate
zones.fingerprintHint: Checkpoint and upgrade hub zones within The Vessel; used to spend Liquid Nacre on upgrades and health increases

abilities.name: Dash/Deflect
abilities.grants: Parry/deflect mechanic in combat; not a traditional dash — no time slow or counter, has a long cooldown on failure
abilities.note: Not reliable for chaining dodges; combat becomes much more engaging once unlocked

abilities.name: Gliding
abilities.grants: Cross large gaps and access new areas
abilities.note: Available later in the game, approximately 8 hours in; requires energy from the Energy System

abilities.name: Orbs
abilities.grants: Ranged projectile attacks against enemies at a distance
abilities.note: Especially useful against flying enemies; referred to as Orbs (Projectile Attacks)

abilities.name: Decoy Clones
abilities.grants: Create decoy clones to distract enemies and attack from multiple directions simultaneously

abilities.name: Grappling
abilities.grants: Grapple to points during traversal and platforming
abilities.note: Requires energy; used in chained platforming sequences; can fall short leading to checkpoint resets

abilities.name: Arachnid Locomotion
abilities.note: Requires energy from the Energy System

abilities.name: Liquid Nacre
abilities.grants: Primary currency; used to purchase upgrades, modifications, and max health at Network Gates
abilities.note: Lost upon death and cannot be recovered; must be spent at Network Gates or converted to Solid Nacre before risky encounters

abilities.name: Solid Nacre
abilities.grants: Permanent currency that is not lost upon death
abilities.note: Converted from Liquid Nacre via conversion robots scattered throughout The Vessel; also found directly in the world — more than can be spent
